notes: Written by jk-01-x on 2026-10-19 from four pages (Uesugi Kenshin, Uesugi Kagekatsu, Yonezawa Domain, Takeda Shingen for the 1565 Kōzuke date). A Sengoku daimyo house that continues as the Yonezawa han inside Cliopatria's single Warring States Japan row and then the Tokugawa shogunate row. Identity runs 1548-1871 with a 1601 rename to Yonezawa Domain. The Kenshin page's 1564 sentence says 'Echizen Province and Kōzuke Province'; read as Echigo and Kōzuke (noted in the keyframe). Not on the pages: Sado, the 1551 unification of Echigo, the places of Otate, the extent of Etchū and Kaga, the Echigo seat (Kasugayama), what became of Etchū after 1582, who received the 1664 cut, and the 1590 Odawara campaign under Maeda Toshiie (a participation, no land). The Yonezawa page lists Gamō as given Aizu in 1591 with wording that does not say the Uesugi governed it; this dossier follows the Kagekatsu page (Aizu to Kagekatsu in 1598). Dates differ: Yonezawa page 1600 for the cut and 1601 for the domain; Kagekatsu page 1601 infobox. Counterparts: 'takeda-clan' and 'later-hojo-clan' have dossiers in this batch; 'oda-clan' does not yet (to be written); 'Tokugawa Ieyasu' and 'Toyotomi Hideyoshi' are persons. The Hōjō dossier files its Kantō wars under 'Uesugi clan (Kantō)' (the Yamanouchi and Ogigayatsu Uesugi); this dossier is the Echigo house that inherited the name in 1561. Area comparison not applicable (no infobox area).
